pathBefore.basis: Finite straight XY center path with a circular body against occupied native wall intervals and full-height hosted doors; exact 2D distances, mm.
limits: Only the explicitly checked wall set is considered. Furniture, door leaves/swing, floors, steps, stairs, other solids and unlisted walls are not checked.
This is not automatic room adjacency, accessibility or evacuation compliance. A clear result only means no collision in this bounded wall/body model.
